title: ECOGEO 'Omics Training: Amplicon Analysis with Mothur
author: Ben Tully
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.fi4bkgw
materials: Move to the directory /home/c-debi/ecogeo/mothurdir and launch mothur.
Begin the process for beta diversity measures.

steps.title: Set working directory and launch Mothur
steps.instruction: Change to the Mothur directory and start the program.

steps.title: Open second terminal for rarefaction
steps.instruction: Open a new terminal window and navigate to the same Mothur directory to perform rarefaction.

steps.title: Generate rarefaction data file
steps.instruction: Execute the rarefaction command in Mothur, which creates a file with data for the rarefaction curve (nano).

steps.title: Inspect taxonomy and shared files
steps.instruction: Use less to view the taxonomy and shared files, confirming that the 0.03.subsample.shared file is present (note: this file was missing in earlier VM versions and is fixed in VM 2.0).

steps.title: Generate dendrogram from distance matrix
steps.instruction: In Mothur, run tree.shared with the phylip distance file to produce a dendrogram, then quit Mothur.

steps.title: View dendrogram tree file
steps.instruction: Display the resulting tree file with less.

steps.title: Load tree into Dendroscope
steps.instruction: Copy the displayed tree content (or the file) and open it in Dendroscope.

description: Alpha diversity measures: mothur > summary.single(shared=stability.an.shared, calc=nseqs-coverage-sobs-invsimpson, subsample=2441)$ less stability.an.groups.ave-std.summary If there is no mothur > summary.single(shared=stability.an.shared, calc=nseqs-coverage-sobs-invsimpson, subsample=2441) $ less stability.an.groups.ave-std.summary If there is no "$" at the beginning of the command, perform it in mothur.
